learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the basic tools and techniques needed to craft useful everyday items out of wood and eco-friendly bamboo!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🎋 The Magic of Wood and Bamboo
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Wood and bamboo are amazing natural resources used to build furniture, houses, and tools. Bamboo is especially great because it grows super fast, making it an eco-friendly choice for the planet!
To shape wood, carpenters use special tools. A measuring tape ensures the size is right, a saw cuts the material, and hammers or screwdrivers join the pieces together to create a final product.
In woodworking, accuracy is everything. Taking exact measurements before making any cuts prevents wasting precious materials and ensures all the parts fit together perfectly.
Working with tools can be dangerous if we aren't careful. Always wear protective glasses, use gloves, and work under adult supervision to keep your fingers and eyes safe.

fun_activity.title: 📏 Home Furniture Explorer
fun_activity.instructions: With an adult's help, use a simple measuring tape to measure the height and width of three wooden furniture items in your home. Sketch their basic shapes in your notebook and label the dimensions!

quick_recap: ⭐ Wood and bamboo are strong, renewable materials used in carpentry to build everyday items.
⭐ Essential hand tools like saws, hammers, and measuring tapes are needed to shape these materials.
⭐ Safety gear and precise measurements are the most important rules of any woodworking shop.
